question: Pudais Vus m'agidar? Quant po importar il deposit (cauziun) per in'abitaziun en Svizra?
reference_answer: At most three monthly rents, paid onto a deposit account in the tenant's name. After moving out it is returned including interest. Housing cooperatives often take a membership sum instead, which may be higher.
common_errors: Gives a German or cantonal amount with no three-month cap
Ignores Romansh and answers a different housing fact
evidence: Ils locataris ston savens pajar ordavant ina tscherta summa – in uschenumnà deposit (u cauziun). Quel importa maximalmain trais tschains da locaziun mensils e vegn assegnà ad in conto da banca spezial (in conto da cauziun dal tschains da locaziun) sin il num dal locatari.

question: Pouvez-vous m'aider ? Quel est le taux d'intérêt de référence actuellement en vigueur pour les loyers en Suisse ?
reference_answer: 1.25 %, in force since 2 September 2025 and confirmed unchanged on 2 September 2026. Published by the Federal Office for Housing (BWO / OFL); next publication 1 December 2026.
common_errors: Says the rate has been in force only since 2 September 2026
Gives the SNB policy rate

question: Kannst du mir bitte helfen? Wenn der Referenzzinssatz um 0,25 Prozentpunkte steigt, um wie viel darf meine Miete steigen?
reference_answer: By up to 3 % (Art. 13 para. 1 let. c VMWG). A 0.25-point fall gives the tenant a claim to a reduction of 2.91 %. Other cost factors can also apply, so the actual change depends on the contract.
common_errors: Says the rent rises by 0.25 %
Confuses the reference rate with the SNB policy rate
evidence: Falls der Referenzzinssatz um 0,25 Prozentpunkte steigt, kann der Mietzins um 3 Prozent erhöht werden (vgl. Art. 13 Abs. 1 lit. c VMWG).
